events.verdict: Johnson (SAS) momentarily brings his arm around Clowney (BKN) after the two players fall to the floor, but he immediately removes it.
Wembanyama (SAS) and Claxton (BKN) jostle for positioning during the rebound and the contact is incidental.
Clowney (BKN) reaches in and makes illegal contact across Wembanyama's (SAS) arms.
Castle (SAS) engages with Thomas (BKN) and disengages as Thomas moves towards the ball.
Claxton (BKN) establishes himself in a legal screening position and does not deliver any illegal contact while setting the pick on Castle (SAS).
Harper (SAS) legally contests Mann's (BKN) jump shot attempt and avoids making any contact.
Wembanyama (SAS) and Claxton (BKN) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Claxton (BKN) moves alongside Castle's (SAS) path and absorbs the contact during the driving shot attempt.
Wembanyama (SAS) steps into Thomas' (BKN) path and foot to foot contact occurs, which trips Thomas at the  start of his drive.
Porter Jr. (BKN) and Vassell (SAS) engage and disengage during the throw-in and the contact is marginal.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that shows the ball comes down onto the baseline and out of bounds after being last touched by Porter Jr. (BKN).
Vassell (SAS) directly contests Porter Jr.'s (BKN) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Porter Jr.'s (BKN) hand after the release.
Claxton (BKN) momentarily grasps and releases Johnson's (SAS) jersey as both players pursue the loose ball.
Clowney (BKN) reaches for the rebound and the ensuing contact with Castle (SAS) is marginal.
Wembanyama (SAS) and Clowney (BKN) come together at the same spot on the floor and the ensuing contact is marginal.
Johnson (SAS) legally contests Clowney's (BKN) jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Claxton (BKN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
The shot clock expires while the Spurs are in possession of the ball.
Coach Fernandez (BKN) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
